tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search open-source GitHub repositories by keywords (hybrid keyword + semantic search) with optional language, topic and star filters.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Details for one repository: stars, forks, language, license, topics, SrcLog score, dates and links.

tools.name: similar_repos
tools.description: Repositories semantically similar to the given one — useful for finding alternatives.

tools.name: topic_repos
tools.description: Most-starred repositories tagged with a topic.

tools.name: top_developers
tools.description: Ranking of GitHub developers or organizations by total stars (or forks, watchers, repos), optionally by language and country.

tools.name: get_owner
tools.description: Profile, totals, ranking positions and most-starred repositories of a GitHub user or organization.
